answers.title: SEO vs AEO vs GEO: What Each Means & How to Sequence
answers.question: What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?
answers.answer: SEO makes a page crawlable, understandable and authoritative enough to rank in a search engine's results; AEO makes it the source a system quotes when it answers a question directly, in featured snippets, People Also Ask and AI Overviews; GEO gets a brand named inside a generated answer from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or Perplexity. They are layers built in that order, not rivals.

answers.title: How to Get Cited by ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity
answers.question: How do you get a brand cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity?
answers.answer: Ranking first in Google no longer guarantees a citation, because retrieval systems judge content differently from rankers. The checklist: make the entity unmistakable, give models clean passages to lift, build topical authority the model has already seen, earn mentions on sites the model ingested, keep facts current, and measure LLM referrals separately.

answers.title: Topic Cluster Architecture That Scales Organic Traffic
answers.question: Why does publishing more content not fix an organic traffic plateau?
answers.answer: A plateau is usually a fragmentation problem, not a volume problem: thirty loosely overlapping posts split authority thinner with every addition. Topic cluster architecture, a pillar page with clusters linked deliberately, concentrates authority so it pools in one place instead of scattering.

answers.title: Query Fan-Out Explorer · Free SEO Tool — Khadija Zaman
answers.question: What is query fan-out?
answers.answer: Query fan-out is the step where Google's AI search and large language models expand one query into many related sub-queries before assembling an answer, as described in Google's query fan-out patent research. This free explorer groups a seed query's expansion into the five sub-query types named in that research: related, implicit, comparative, recent and personal.
